information.description:
A Brutalizer pumped full of combat chrome, drugs and firepower; it takes power tools to crack one.

Animals: A gang that worships raw muscle, fed on hormone cocktails and grafted bone.

Stat block from Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis, unofficial content under R. Talsorian Games' Homebrew Content Policy. Portrait: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.

description.value: Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

Animals Jackhammer: Can expend both shells at once to deal +2d6 damage (5d6).

No capacity attachments, Shotgun Shells only. Fire both barrels at once for +2d6 (5d6).

Class: EQ Shotgun • POWER
Range table: Short Barrel Shotgun
Damage: 3d6/5d6
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell
Built-in: Power Rebuild

Item Compendium (2070) • Weapons

Primary (4 hours): the first damage you take each Round, after armor, is 1 less (2 if it came with a Critical Injury); COOL and TECH −2 (min 1); no fear, and you act like it. Secondary (DV17): addicted; without a dose, −2 to Athletics, Concentration, Endurance, Perception, Stealth and Tactics.

Cost: 100eb

Item Compendium (2070) • Drugs

Primary Effect

Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user rolls 2d6 Humanity Loss which is returned if they pass the Secondary Effect save
  • The user ignores Seriously Wounded wound states for the duration

Secondary Effect (DV17)

When the dose wears off, the user rolls WILL + Resist Torture/Drugs + 1d10 against Secondary DV.

  • On Fail Humanity loss is not returned
  • Unless experiencing the primary effect, REF -2

BODY +2, changing HP, Wound Threshold and Death Save. Stacks, but can't raise BODY above 10.

Install: Hospital • HL: 14 (4d6)

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware

Required for all non-medical cyberware. Contains: Neural Link (5 Neuralware slots, none used by the rest), Holophone, Biomonitor, Virtu (virtual experiences; full immersion when deep diving), HUD (labels, transcripts, subtitles; shown in any cybereye, replacing the Chyron), two Shard Slots (chipware sockets) and a Personal Link (pull-out interface plug). Has a basic firewall (Chapter 10 of the Core Rules).

Install: Hospital • HL: 7 (2d6)

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware

Up to 3. Each adds a Passwall to your Neuroport; all your Passwalls become DV6 / DV8 / DV10 with 1 / 2 / 3 installs.

Install: Hospital • HL: 3 (1d6)

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware

Body and head SP11. Same stacking and self-repair rules as Skin Weave.

Install: Hospital • HL: 14 (4d6)
